info.title: QA Practice Lab — Meridian Outfitters Practice API
info.description:
Machine-checkable description of the /api/v1 contract served by the QA Practice Lab (Meridian Outfitters, a fictional commerce domain). This document describes the *documented, clean-mode contract*: the behaviour a correct implementation answers with. It never says which browser sessions run in an exercise mode, and it never contains internal identifiers.

General rules that apply to every /api/v1 route unless stated otherwise:
- Money is always integer cents in the fictional `USD` currency.
- Every API error answer carries the documented envelope `{ "error": string, "message": string }` (see `Error`); per-endpoint error-code vocabularies are listed per operation and in `components.schemas.ErrorCode`.
- All /api responses are sent with `Cache-Control: no-store` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- The API is served same-origin. Authentication is cookie-based (`mpl_session`, `mpl_customer`) or, for the `mpl_customer` surface, `Authorization: Bearer <token>` minted by `POST /api/v1/auth/token` (SHA-256-hashed at rest, 15-900 s clamped TTL, one-time display). When a Bearer header is presented it wins over the cookie; roles always come from the stored customer row. An expired Bearer token answers 401 `token_expired`; other Bearer failures answer 401 `unauthorized`.
- Mutating routes (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) are subject to a shared per-IP abuse budget (`rate_limited`, 429) plus a 32 KB JSON body cap (`payload_too_large`, 413); both are abuse controls, not security boundaries. Scoped budgets exist for login (`login_rate_limited`), checkout (`rate_limited`, 30/min), bug-report submission (`rate_limited`, 30/min), practice-hunt starts (`hunt_start_cap_reached`, 20/IP/UTC day) and SQL evaluation (`rate_limited`, 30/min); `POST /api/v1/sql/evaluate` accepts up to 1 MB of JSON.
- Ownership is concealed: unknown and not-owned/not-permitted references answer the identical 404 `not_found` envelope. Existence is never revealed.
- The Meridian Outfitters domain is a synthetic training environment. Accounts, orders and inventory are fictitious; no real payments, credentials or personal records exist.

license.name: Synthetic training environment — not a production API

servers.description: Same-origin (relative). Requests always target the same origin that served this document.

tags.name: cart
tags.description: Session-scoped practice cart. Resolved from the mpl_session cookie.

tags.name: checkout
tags.description: Checkout summary and simulated order placement (atomic, idempotent). Payment is a deterministic simulation; nothing is really paid for or shipped.

tags.name: orders
tags.description: Session-scoped order history, immutable order confirmations and cancellation.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Synthetic demo sign-in, sign-out, practice API token mint and the safe demo-account directory. Not a production identity system.

tags.name: account
tags.description: Protected customer resources: own profile and own order history.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Staff-only surfaces (inventory management). Exercise requires the synthetic staff demo account.

tags.name: practice
tags.description: Practice-session engine, bug-hunt attempts, structured bug reports, hints, gated reveals and learner progress.

get.description: Alias of `GET /api/v1/auth/me`: the full protected profile for the signed-in synthetic customer. Identical success and error behaviour.

401.description: Not signed in. Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but the account was suspended. Error code: `account_suspended`.

get.description: Order history for the signed-in synthetic customer — every practice session, newest first, at most 50 entries. Distinct from the session-scoped `GET /api/v1/orders`. Requires the `mpl_customer` cookie.

401.description: Not signed in. Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but the account was suspended. Error code: `account_suspended`.

get.summary: Get one of the account's orders
get.description: Immutable order confirmation owned by the signed-in customer. Requires both the reference and account ownership; unknown, foreign and not-owned references answer the identical 404 `not_found` envelope. Requires the `mpl_customer` cookie.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Order reference: `ORD-` followed by 16 upper-case hex characters.

401.description: Not signed in. Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but the account was suspended. Error code: `account_suspended`.

404.description: Unknown, foreign or not-owned reference. Error code: `not_found`.

get.description: Full inventory view for the staff demo account: every product (including discontinued ones) with quantity, low-stock threshold, price and stock status. Requires the `mpl_customer` cookie with the synthetic **staff** role; a guest answers 401 `unauthorized`, a suspended staff account 403 `account_suspended`, and a non-staff active account 403 `staff_required`. Authorization is decided solely from the stored customer row.

200.description: The full inventory list and its row count.

401.description: Not signed in (or the customer session is unknown/expired). Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but not an active staff account. Error codes: `account_suspended`, `staff_required`.

patch.description: Adds units to a product's stock. Staff-only, exactly as the read surface. The adjustment is recorded in an append-only audit trail; the stock update and the audit row commit atomically. The total per product may never exceed 1,000,000 units (`stock_limit_exceeded`). Discontinued (inactive) products may still be restocked.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Numeric product id (1–10 digits).

200.description: The restocked inventory row and the recorded adjustment.

400.description: Malformed product id, body or quantity/note. Error code: `invalid_request` (per-field `fields` map included).

401.description: Not signed in (or the customer session is unknown/expired). Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but not an active staff account. Error codes: `account_suspended`, `staff_required`.

404.description: No product with that id. Error code: `not_found`.

422.description: The restock would breach the 1,000,000-unit per-product ceiling. Error code: `stock_limit_exceeded` (carries `maxQuantity` and `currentQuantity`).

post.description: Operator-invoked bounded cleanup: deletes expired practice sessions, expired customer sessions, stale hunt-start cap rows and dead rate-limit buckets (≤ 100 rows per table per call). Idempotent. Inventory adjustments and order cancellations are never deleted. Not part of the learner exercise surface; there is no cron on Pages Functions. Requires the synthetic staff role.

200.description: How many rows were deleted, per table.

401.description: Not signed in (or the customer session is unknown/expired). Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but not an active staff account. Error codes: `account_suspended`, `staff_required`.

get.description: Safe directory of the fictional training accounts (name, email, role, status) for the sign-in screen. Never carries password material. The demo passwords are documented in the lab README; they are not secrets and are only useful against this synthetic environment.

post.summary: Sign in a synthetic demo account
post.description: Authenticates a synthetic demo account. On success the browser receives (or keeps) a `mpl_session` practice-session cookie and a fresh `mpl_customer` customer-session cookie (8h TTL, bound to the practice session). Unknown emails and wrong passwords answer the identical 401 `invalid_credentials` envelope; the unknown-email path still performs a password verification against a dummy hash so timing does not enumerate accounts. Five failed attempts per IP per UTC minute lock further attempts with 429 `login_rate_limited` (a successful sign-in clears the budget). Suspended accounts answer 403 `account_suspended`. This is a training simulation — there is no registration, password reset, MFA or external identity provider.

200.description: Signed in. Sets/refreshes the `mpl_session` and `mpl_customer` cookies (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, `Secure` over HTTPS).

400.description: Missing or malformed email/password. Error code: `invalid_request`.

401.description: Unknown email or wrong password (indistinguishable). Error code: `invalid_credentials`.

403.description: The account exists but is suspended. Error code: `account_suspended`.

429.description: Five failed attempts from this IP in the current UTC minute. Error code: `login_rate_limited`. `Retry-After` header included.

post.description: Deletes the caller's `mpl_customer` customer session (if any) and clears the cookie. Also revokes every practice API token bound to the account (customer-scoped, deliberately broad and documented — signing out anywhere signs out everywhere). Idempotent: a guest answers `{ "ok": true }` too. The anonymous practice session (`mpl_session`) is unaffected.

200.description: Signed out (or was never signed in).

get.description: The signed-in synthetic customer's profile. Identical payload to `GET /api/v1/account`. Requires the `mpl_customer` cookie; a guest answers 401, a suspended account answers 403.

401.description: Not signed in (or the customer session is unknown/expired/bound to another practice session). Error code: `unauthorized`, or `token_expired` for an expired Bearer token.

403.description: Signed in, but the account was suspended. Error code: `account_suspended`.

post.summary: Mint a synthetic practice API token
post.description: Re-authenticates a synthetic demo account (same verification, same dummy-hash timing equalization and the same 5-failures/IP/UTC-minute budget as POST /api/v1/auth/login — the counter is shared, deliberately) and issues an opaque 256-bit practice API token, returned once in the 201 body. Only the token's SHA-256 hash is stored server-side. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` anywhere this contract accepts the `mpl_customer` cookie; when both are present the Bearer token wins. There is no refresh and no renewal — minting again is the only path. Sign-out revokes every token bound to the account. `expiresInSeconds` is clamped server-side to 15-900 (default 900). Suspended accounts answer 403.

201.description: Token minted. The raw token appears in this response exactly once and is never stored or returned again.

400.description: Missing or malformed email/password, or an expiresInSeconds that is not a finite number. Error code: `invalid_request`.

401.description: Unknown email or wrong password (indistinguishable). Error code: `invalid_credentials`.

403.description: The account exists but is suspended. Error code: `account_suspended`.

429.description: Five failed attempts from this IP in the current UTC minute (shared with sign-in). Error code: `login_rate_limited`. `Retry-After` header included.

get.description: Returns the cart belonging to the caller's `mpl_session` cookie. An anonymous or unknown browser answers an empty cart (`itemCount: 0`) and clears any stale cookie. Prices, stock and totals are always recomputed server-side from the catalogue and inventory at read time.

delete.summary: Remove every line from the cart
delete.description: Deletes all lines in the caller's cart. Idempotent: an empty or missing cart answers the same empty-cart payload.

post.summary: Add a product to the cart
post.description: Adds `quantity` units of a product by slug. Prices and totals are recomputed server-side; the client sends only `{ slug, quantity }`. Mints the `mpl_session` cookie on first use (the first cart mutation creates the anonymous practice session). Lines are only accepted up to available stock.

400.description: Malformed body, missing/invalid slug, or quantity outside 1–99 (integer). Error code: `invalid_request`.

404.description: No active product with that slug. Error code: `not_found`.

422.description: Stock guard rejected the add. Error codes: `out_of_stock` (product has none left) or `insufficient_stock` (would exceed remaining/line cap; the response carries `availableStock`, `maxQuantity` and, where relevant, `currentQuantity`).

patch.description: Replaces the quantity of one cart line. `id` is the line's numeric id as returned by `GET /api/v1/cart`; it must be a positive integer. Quantity must be an integer 1–99 and within available stock.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Cart line id (positive integer, no leading zero).

400.description: Malformed line id, body, or quantity. Error code: `invalid_request`.

404.description: No such line in the caller's cart (or no session). Error code: `not_found`.

422.description: Quantity exceeds fulfillable stock or the line cap. Error code: `insufficient_stock`.

delete.summary: Remove one line from the cart
delete.description: Deletes a single line by id. Idempotent only in the sense that a missing line answers 404; it is not silently ignored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Cart line id (positive integer, no leading zero).

404.description: No such line in the caller's cart (or no session). Error code: `not_found`.

get.description: All catalogue categories in display order.

Cart-derived checkout summary: the same lines as `GET /api/v1/cart` plus a `checkoutable` flag. `checkoutable` is true only when the cart is non-empty and every line is fulfillable. An anonymous browser answers an empty, non-checkoutable summary.

post.description: Places the order for the caller's cart. Payment is a deterministic simulation (`approved` places the order, `declined` places nothing); nothing is really paid for or shipped. The order is computed server-side from the catalogue and inventory — the client never dictates prices or totals. Placement is atomic (all-or-nothing) and idempotent: send an `Idempotency-Key` header (or `idempotencyKey` in the body) matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{7,127}$`; a replay with the same key and the same payload re-answers the recorded outcome (HTTP 201, `Idempotent-Replay: true` response header). Reusing a key for a different payload answers 409. Successful placements return the immutable order confirmation with status 201.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated idempotency key. 8–128 chars: letters, digits, dashes, underscores; must start with a letter or digit. One is generated server-side when absent.

201.description: Order placed (or the recorded outcome replayed). The body is the immutable order confirmation. When this response replays a previous submission, the `Idempotent-Replay: true` header is set.

Idempotent-Replay.description: Set to `true` only when this response replays a previously recorded idempotency outcome.

400.description: Validation failed (per-field `fields` map included), or the idempotency key is malformed. Error code: `invalid_request`.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used for a different payload. Error code: `idempotency_conflict`.

422.description: The order cannot be placed. Error codes: `empty_cart` (nothing to buy / no live session), `payment_declined` (the simulated decline; cart and stock untouched), `cart_unavailable` (one or more lines cannot be fulfilled; carries a `lines` array of `{ slug, name, reason, availableStock }`).

429.description: Too many order attempts from this network (30 placements/IP/minute, counted including invalid payloads). Error code: `rate_limited`. `Retry-After` header included. The shared per-IP mutation budget also applies.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the oldest counted attempt ages out of the fixed window.

get.description: The caller's order history, newest first, at most 50 entries. Scoped to the practice session; a signed-in customer's account history lives at `GET /api/v1/account/orders`. An anonymous browser answers an empty list.

Immutable order snapshot, readable only by the practice session that placed it (or, when signed in, the customer account that owns it — see `GET /api/v1/account/orders/{reference}`). Unknown references, foreign references and malformed references answer the identical envelope where applicable: existence is never revealed.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Order reference: `ORD-` followed by 16 upper-case hex characters.

404.description: Unknown, foreign or unauthorised reference. Error code: `not_found`.

post.description: Transitions `placed → cancelled` exactly once and restores stock exactly once, atomically. Safe to retry: a repeat call replays the already-cancelled order (HTTP 200) without restoring stock twice. Authorization mirrors the read policy: the practice session that placed the order, or the signed-in customer that owns it. Unknown, foreign and unauthorised references alike answer 404. Cancelling mints nothing and accepts no body.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Order reference: `ORD-` followed by 16 upper-case hex characters.

404.description: Unknown, foreign or unauthorised reference. Error code: `not_found`.

get.description: Bounded history (≤ 50, newest first) of the caller's attempts: session-scoped rows plus customer-bound rows when signed in. An anonymous or unknown browser answers an empty list. Never exposes internal identifiers.

Learner-safe list of the bug-hunt exercises available in this deployment: hunt id, title, summary, the wired catalogue scenario id and curriculum metadata. Never carries internal identifiers, hint content or reveal content. Read-only; no session required.

200.description: The registered hunts, in registry order.

get.summary: Read the caller's attempt for a hunt
get.description: The caller's current attempt state for one hunt: status, hints used, best evaluated score, discovery flag and first submission time. A caller with no attempt answers `{ status: "none", hintsUsed: 0, bestQualityScore: null, discovered: false, submittedAt: null }` (200, never 404). Unknown hunt ids answer 404. Never mints an attempt.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-catalogue-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

post.description: Unlocks hint level 1, 2 or 3 for the caller's attempt at the hunt. Level N requires level N−1 already unlocked (`hint_level_locked`); levels cannot be skipped. Re-requesting an already-unlocked level is idempotent (200, no double count). No new level unlocks after the attempt is complete (`hint_attempt_completed`). Requires a live practice session. The hint text is served only for the requested level.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-catalogue-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

200.description: The unlocked hint and the number of distinct levels used on the attempt.

400.description: `level` is not exactly 1, 2 or 3. Error code: `invalid_level` (malformed hunt id answers `invalid_request` instead).

401.description: No live practice session. Error code: `session_required`.

409.description: The hint cannot be unlocked. Error codes: `hint_level_locked` (a lower level is missing) or `hint_attempt_completed` (the attempt is no longer in progress).

post.description: Persists the structured report, evaluates it deterministically (rule-based, no AI — the client can never influence the score), and returns the stored report with the evaluation. The response carries no internal identifiers. Requires a live practice session. Submissions are capped at 30 per IP per UTC minute; over the cap the answer is 429 `rate_limited` (counted before the body is parsed). The `report:<iphash>` budget and the shared per-IP mutation budget both apply.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-catalogue-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

201.description: The report was stored and evaluated. The body contains the learner-safe report view and the deterministic evaluation.

400.description: Validation failed (per-field `fields` map included). Error code: `invalid_request`.

401.description: No live practice session. Error code: `session_required`.

429.description: Too many report submissions from this network (30/minute). Error code: `rate_limited`. `Retry-After` header included.

get.description: The gated solution for the caller's attempt at the hunt. Served only when the attempt's report has been submitted or the attempt was explicitly revealed (confirmed give-up); otherwise 403 `reveal_locked`. Never mints an attempt. Hints never unlock the reveal; a score never unlocks the reveal.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-catalogue-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

200.description: The solution reveal plus the learner-safe attempt snapshot.

403.description: Not yet eligible: no submitted report and no confirmed give-up (this also covers having no attempt, and being a guest). Error code: `reveal_locked`.

post.summary: Explicitly give up and reveal the solution
post.description: The confirmed give-up path. Body must be exactly `{ "confirm": true }`; anything else answers 400. Atomically marks the caller's in-progress attempt `revealed` (a submitted attempt stays `submitted`) and returns the same payload as the GET. Idempotent: repeating preserves prior state. Never awards discovery; submissions, best score and discovery status are preserved untouched.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-catalogue-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

200.description: The solution reveal plus the learner-safe attempt snapshot.

400.description: `confirm` is not exactly `true` (or the hunt id is malformed). Error code: `invalid_request`.

401.description: No live practice session. Error code: `session_required`.

post.summary: Enter bug-hunt mode for a hunt
post.description: Re-stamps the caller's live practice session into bug-hunt mode for the given hunt (restarting the same hunt is idempotent and does not consume the daily cap). Takes no body. Unknown hunt ids answer 404. Hunt starts are capped at 20 per IP per UTC day (`hunt_start_cap_reached`); the cap is an abuse control, not a security boundary. Also ensures an in-progress attempt exists for the (session, hunt) pair.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-catalogue-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

200.description: Bug-hunt mode is now active for the caller's session.

429.description: The daily hunt-start cap for this IP was reached. Error code: `hunt_start_cap_reached`. `Retry-After` header included.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the UTC day rolls over.

get.description: Aggregate over the caller's attempts and submitted reports: per-wired-hunt status/discovery/best score, the 10 newest submissions with their deterministic verdicts, and totals. Owner-scoped (session, plus customer binding when signed in); never cross-customer and never admin-readable. A caller with no live session answers an empty, well-formed payload (200) rather than an error. Discovery is never derived from a score and never set by a reveal.

Whether the caller's practice session is in `clean` or `bug_hunt` mode, and (in bug-hunt mode) the learner-safe hunt summary. An anonymous or unknown browser answers clean mode. Read-only; mints nothing.

post.summary: Return the session to clean mode
post.description: Non-destructively re-stamps the caller's live session to clean mode (cart, orders and the customer binding are preserved). Mints a fresh clean session when the browser has none. Takes no body. Never counts against the hunt-start cap.

get.description: Page-based catalogue listing. Out-of-range `page`/`perPage` values are clamped, not rejected; unknown `sort` values fall back to `newest`; an unknown `category` slug simply matches zero rows. `q` matches name, description and category name case-insensitively; LIKE wildcards are treated literally.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Clamped to ≥ 1 and ≤ 10000; non-integer values fall back to 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Page size. Clamped to 1–48; non-integer values fall back to 12.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug filter (lower-cased, ≤ 64 chars). An unknown slug yields an empty result set with `total: 0`, not an error.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Unknown values fall back to `newest`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (≤ 80 chars after trimming). Matches product name, description and category name; `%`, `_` and `\` are matched literally.

200.description: A page of products with server-computed pagination metadata.

get.description: Case-insensitive slug lookup over active products. The slug must match `^[a-z0-9-]{1,80}$` after lower-casing; anything else answers 404, like a well-formed slug that does not exist.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Product slug, e.g. `canvas-tote-bag`.

404.description: Unknown or malformed slug. Error code: `not_found`.

post.summary: Evaluate a submitted result set for a SQL exercise
post.description: Compares a learner's submitted result envelope (`{columns, rows}` from the in-browser sandbox) against the exercise's compiled expected specification. Learner SQL is never accepted or executed server-side; comparison is result-based (multiset by default, ordered when the exercise demands it), integer-exact for cents, NULL-safe, case-insensitive for column names, and never persisted beyond the attempt stamp. Passing (score ≥ 70) stamps the caller's attempt `submitted` with the running-max score; failing leaves it `in_progress`. Per-IP scoped budget: 30/min (`rate_limited`), plus the shared mutation backstop and a 1 MB JSON cap.

200.description: The deterministic verdict: pass/fail, score 0-100, per-check feedback and the attempt lifecycle status.

400.description: Malformed envelope (columns/rows caps, duplicate column names, bad cells). Error code: `invalid_request`.

401.description: No live practice session. Error code: `session_required`.

post.summary: Start (or resume) a SQL exercise attempt
post.description: Idempotently opens the caller's live in-progress attempt for a registered SQL exercise — mirroring hunt-start idempotency. If the browser has no live practice session, a clean guest one is minted first (same semantics as a hunt start). Returns the same attempt row on re-entry; never creates a second live attempt. Unknown ids answer 404 `exercise_not_found`. Attempts on SQL exercises reuse the same attempt bookkeeping as hunts; no client may tune anything about an attempt.

parameters.name: exerciseId
parameters.description: SQL exercise id, e.g. `sql-bgn-select-01`. Must match `^sql-(bgn|int|adv)-[a-z0-9-]+-[0-9]{2}$`.

get.summary: Load the bug-hunt sandbox delta for a SQL hunt
get.description: Returns the compiled corruption delta for a registered SQL data-integrity hunt, applied in the learner's browser sandbox on top of the canonical practice snapshot. Served only to the caller whose live practice session is in bug-hunt mode for that exact hunt — clean mode answers 403 `not_hunt_mode` (unknown hunts answer 404 `not_found`; non-SQL hunts answer the same 404 so existence is never disclosed). Idempotent; writes nothing to the database. The delta is exercise content, not executable learner input.

parameters.name: huntId
parameters.description: Hunt id, e.g. `hunt-db-001`. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`.

200.description: The compiled corruption delta for this hunt (learner-safe bytes; applied client-side only).

401.description: No live practice session. Error code: `session_required`.

403.description: Live session is not in bug-hunt mode for this SQL hunt. Error code: `not_hunt_mode`.

404.description: No such hunt (including non-SQL hunts). Error code: `not_found`.

practiceSessionCookie.name: mpl_session
practiceSessionCookie.description: Anonymous practice-session cookie (7-day TTL). Only the SHA-256 hash of the opaque token is stored server-side. Minted automatically by the first cart mutation, an explicit hunt start/reset, or a login. Resolves the practice session that owns the cart, orders, attempts and hint state.

customerCookie.name: mpl_customer
customerCookie.description: Synthetic customer-session cookie (8h TTL), bound to the practice session that established it. Issued only by POST /api/v1/auth/login for the synthetic demo accounts. Carries no intrinsic role — the role is read from the stored customer row on every request.

bearerAuth.description: Synthetic practice API token (opaque 256-bit value, SHA-256-hashed at rest). Minted only by POST /api/v1/auth/token for the synthetic demo accounts. Short-lived (15-900 s, clamped server-side) and not bound to a practice session — an API credential must outlive the tab that minted it. The role and status are read from the stored customer row on every request; the token carries no claims and can never elevate them. Revoked on sign-out; expired rows are purged by the operator maintenance sweep.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body declares a Content-Length over the cap (32 KB for most routes; 1 MB for `POST /api/v1/sql/evaluate`) or an invalid one. Error code: `payload_too_large`.

MutateRateLimited.description: Too many mutating requests from this network (shared 120 mutations/IP/minute backstop). Error code: `rate_limited`. `Retry-After` header included.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the oldest counted request ages out of the fixed window.

ErrorCode.description: Every error code this API documents. The catalogue of codes matches the server implementation; unknown codes never appear.

Error.description: The documented error envelope. `error` is a stable machine-readable code (see `ErrorCode`); `message` is human-readable and safe to show a learner.

ErrorWithFields.description: Error envelope with per-field validation messages (validation failures only).

InsufficientStockError.description: Error envelope for stock-guard rejections. `availableStock` is the current inventory quantity; `maxQuantity` the effective per-line ceiling; `currentQuantity` (only when adding to an existing line) is the line's quantity before the attempted add.

CartUnavailableLine.description: One cart line that blocks checkout.

CartUnavailableError.description: Error envelope for `cart_unavailable`: one or more lines cannot be fulfilled right now.

StockLimitExceededError.description: Error envelope for `stock_limit_exceeded`: the restock would breach the 1,000,000-unit per-product ceiling.

example.name: Canvas Tote Bag
example.description: Heavy-weight 16oz canvas tote with reinforced handles.

CartResponse.description: The server-recomputed cart. `subtotalCents` equals `totalCents` today (no shipping, discounts or tax exist in this domain). Lines that cannot be fulfilled stay in the cart flagged `available: false` and block checkout.

CheckoutSummary.description: Cart summary for the checkout step: everything in `CartResponse` plus `checkoutable`.

OrderDetail.description: Immutable order confirmation. `status` is `placed` on the wire until a cancellation is recorded, at which point reads derive `cancelled`. `cancelledAt` is the cancellation timestamp or null.

CheckoutRequest.description: Checkout details. Only synthetic data is accepted — never real card, banking or personal-record data; `paymentSimulation` is a deterministic outcome switch, not a payment instrument.

TokenRequest.description: Practice API token mint. Re-authenticates the synthetic demo account exactly like POST /api/v1/auth/login (same shared failure budget, same 429) — minting is a credential issuance, not a registration flow.

expiresInSeconds.description: Desired lifetime in seconds. Clamped server-side to 15-900; out-of-range values are clamped, not rejected. Defaults to 900.

ApiTokenResponse.description: 201 Created. The raw token appears in this response exactly once — it is never stored, logged or returned again. Minting requires valid credentials; there is no renewal flow (mint a new token instead).

token.description: Opaque 256-bit practice token, hex encoded (64 characters).

expiresIn.description: Effective TTL in seconds after the server-side 15-900 clamp.

InventoryAdjustment.description: The audit row recorded for a restock.

HuntCurriculum.description: Learner-safe curriculum metadata: what to practise, never the answer.

ReportEvaluation.description: The deterministic rule-based evaluation of one submission (score 0–100; ≥80 solid · 50–79 needs-work · <50 incomplete).

BugReportView.description: The stored report, echoed back learner-safe. `qualityScore` and `feedback` are the persisted deterministic evaluation — never client-supplied.

HuntReveal.description: The solution reveal. Content is served only after reveal eligibility (submitted report or confirmed give-up).
